items.evidence: We view this as our fundamental license to operate.
Operational (VCIP only) As an E&P company, strong operational performance is essential for delivering on our commitments to stockholders.
The Financial metrics in our compensation programs strongly align with our returns-focused strategy and are core to delivering our value proposition
Strategic Milestones are set annually for VCIP, and, prior to the performance share program commencing in 2019, Strategic Objectives were also included in the PSP.
Relative Total Shareholder Return (VCIP and PSP) We believe it is important to include TSR in both VCIP and PSP because it is the most tangible, visible measure
We include relative Total Recordable Rate and absolute Process Safety Events in our compensation metrics
Process Safety Events refers to the control of process hazards in a facility with the potential to impact people, property, or the environment.
our operational compensation metrics include absolute targets for Production, Capital, Operating and Overhead Costs, and Operational Milestones.
Operating and Overhead Costs The target was set at $5.3 billion, which excluded adjustments for closed and expected 2020 acquisitions
Our Operational Milestones are intended to drive a focus on key actions or decisions that support delivery of our plan.
An absolute target for Adjusted ROCE was set in accordance with the budget and strategic plans
An evaluation of performance relative to peers is also an important component of the Financial measure
Relative Total Shareholder Return (VCIP and PSP)
Stock-based, long-term incentives make up the largest portion of performance-based pay.
